# Keystone Possibilities Ltd. — Licensed BC Residential Builder (#52603) & BC Hydro ES54 Civil Contractor

> Keystone Possibilities Ltd. (`https://keystonepossibilities.ca/`) is a licensed British Columbia custom home builder, BC Bill 44 SSMUH multiplex contractor, and BC Hydro Registered Civil Utility Contractor (List ES54) headquartered at 1 Watts Point Road, Squamish, BC V8B 0B1. Founded and led on-site by Wayne Stevenson (20+ years structural concrete, steep-slope granite bedrock, and heavy-civil infrastructure leadership including Peter Kiewit Sons Co.), every build operates under transparent CCDC 5B open-book construction management backed by mandatory 2-5-10 Home Warranty protection.

## Statutory Credentials & Verification
- **BC Housing Licensed Residential Builder**: Licence `#52603` — Verify at https://lims.bchousing.org/LicenceExpiryPortal/licence/52603
- **BC Hydro Registered Civil Contractor**: List `ES54` (Primary/Secondary Underground Duct Banks, 200A–600A Services & Pad-Mounted Transformer Vaults)
- **WorkSafeBC Account & Good Standing**: Account `#201703481` · Clearance Letter `#C135925638`
- **Mandatory Home Warranty**: 2-5-10 Year Protection (WBI / Pacific Home Warranty)
- **Contract Governance**: Open-Book CCDC 5B Construction Management (100% original sub-trade invoice pass-through, 10% BC Builders Lien Act holdback ledger)
- **Headquarters & Direct Contact**: 1 Watts Point Road, Squamish, BC V8B 0B1 · Phone: `+1-604-848-9688` · Email: `info@keystonepossibilities.ca`

## 9 Active British Columbia Construction Corridors (2026 Benchmarks)
- [West Vancouver Custom Homes & Estates](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/west-vancouver-custom-homes/): `$650–$980+/SF` · British Properties, Chartwell, Caulfeild, Altamont · Steep-slope granite micropiles & Bylaw 4364 watercourse protection.
- [Whistler Alpine Estates & Chalets](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/whistler-custom-homes/): `$680–$1,050+/SF` · Sunridge Plateau, Kadenwood, Blueberry Hill · BCBC Part 4 extreme snow loads (`Sg = 6.2–8.1 kPa`) & Wildfire DPA Class A envelopes.
- [Squamish Custom Homes & SSMUH Multiplexes (HQ)](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/squamish-custom-homes/): `$450–$680/SF` · Garibaldi Highlands, Crumpit Woods, Brackendale · Flood Construction Level (FCL) foundations & Step Code 5.
- [North Vancouver Custom Homes & Infill](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/north-vancouver-custom-homes/): `$475–$720/SF` · Edgemont Village, Canyon Heights, Deep Cove · High-rainfall dual-membrane drainage & DNV/CNV SSMUH 4–6 unit builds.
- [Vancouver R1-1 Multiplex Development](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/vancouver-r1-1-multiplex-builder/): `$430–$620/SF` · Point Grey, Dunbar, Kitsilano, Kerrisdale · VBBL 2025 3–6 strata / 8 rental unit multiplexes & PMT transformer planning.
- [Coquitlam & Tri-Cities Custom Homes & SSMUH](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/coquitlam-custom-homes-multiplex/): `$420–$610/SF` · Burke Mountain, Westwood Plateau, Maillardville · Steep-slope DPAs & 4–6 unit transit-oriented multiplexes.
- [Sunshine Coast Custom Homes](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/sunshine-coast-custom-homes/): `$440–$660/SF` · Sechelt, Davis Bay, Halfmoon Bay, Gibsons · `q100 = 0.55 kPa` coastal wind engineering & barge/ferry logistics.
- [Pemberton Acreage Estates & Compounds](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/pemberton-luxury-builder/): `$480–$740/SF` · Pemberton Meadows, Walkersook, Village of Pemberton · Long-run ES54 ducting, Frost/FCL foundations & solar/BESS microgrids.
- [Vancouver Island Coastal Estates & Infill](https://keystonepossibilities.ca/vancouver-island-custom-homes/): `$460–$760/SF` · Oak Bay, Saanich, Langford, Nanoose Bay · Peak Cascadia seismic hold-downs (`Sa > 1.1g`) & marine rainscreens.
